name: Sarah Knafo - Après le § 103 - Am 8
title: REPORT on European technological sovereignty and digital infrastructure
part_text: 103a. Stresses that the high energy costs for the operation of digital infrastructure are penalising European companies and undermining their competitiveness compared to non-EU competitors that benefit from lower energy prices; stresses that the EU’s energy policies should ensure access to stable and affordable electricity for strategic industries, including data centres, high-performance computing infrastructure and energy-intensive sectors; strongly underlines the need for actions aimed at reducing volatility and lowering high energy prices, which have a significant impact on EU businesses; urges the Commission and the Member States, following adequate impact assessment and consultation with the stakeholders concerned, to put forward ways to decouple electricity prices from fossil fuel prices;
